prompt: Promotions to higher level should be from within company and not to a new person from outside. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Promoting to an executive level should come from within a company rather than appointing an outsider. This essay completely agrees with this statement because it will lead to an improvement in mutual trust between an employer and an employee and increase the employee’s productivity.

Employees promoted to higher positions should be selected among the working members because it fosters a stronger relationship between employers and employees. The reason is that if the current employee, who is someone from the lower hierarchy of the company, gets a promotion, he will give his best to remove the obstacles that low-level workers face in the most efficient way, because he is someone who climbed from that place and is aware of the difficulties his former colleagues encounter. Thus, eliminating those problems will increase the business’s overall performance manyfold, resulting in a robust relationship between both parties. For example, Artel, one of the leading companies of Uzbekistan, promoted 10 new head managers, as a result, the company expanded its influence , and its annual profit surged by 10 %.

Another reason why existing employees should rise to an executive role is the fact that it boosts the efficiency of employees. That is to say that it will have a phenomenal impact on other staff members and encourage them to strive more so that one day they can also get promoted to a higher level if they work hard enough, because their former colleague got promoted in front of their eyes. As a result, this will boost their morale and efficiency in the projects they are working on. 

In conclusion, I believe that companies should promote existing employees instead of recruiting external candidates because this strengthens the relationship between employers and employees while improving employees' work efficiency.
